notes: This file is THE single source of truth for versions, models, SystemSKUs, hashes and INF counts.
The README, validation scripts, deployment logic, stick documentation and the DOCX/PDF manuals derive their values from this file.
All files come from official Microsoft servers (download.microsoft.com / tlu.dl.delivery.mp.microsoft.com).
SHA-256 values were computed locally after download and validated against valid Authenticode signatures from Microsoft Corporation.
INF counts were determined by full msiexec /a extraction and recursive counting; reconfirmed by test-extracting every archive.
RSS-Deploy itself never uses the internet; this manifest is intended for rebuilding and validating the stick and travels on the Images partition.
Freshness check: 2026-10-02 against learn.microsoft.com, support.microsoft.com and the Microsoft Download Center pages (see docs/source for source references).

diskSafety.targetDiskRule: only the single internal NVMe disk; in WinPE that is Disk 0
rules: UNKNOWN  = STOP - unknown model, empty SystemSKU or unknown SKU
AMBIGUOUS = STOP - zero or multiple candidate data partitions, multiple NVMe disks
UNSUPPORTED = STOP - unsupported model, ARM/Snapdragon, wrong CPU vendor, refused SKU
MISSING  = STOP - missing image, archive, manifest or load order
INVALID  = STOP - hash mismatch, unreadable archive, wrong INF count, Disk 0 not NVMe
diskSafety.deploymentUsbNeverTarget: the USB data partition may never sit on Disk 0 and may never be the NVMe target disk
